title: [Radio’Clock] Tea Time Monday with Kim Yoon-ha (김윤하)
description:
상반기가 지나가고, 하반기가 시작되면 자연스럽게 떠오르는 분이죠!💖
김윤하 평론가님과 함께 했습니다🍒

오늘도 2024년 상반기를 돌아보며, 여러 이야기들을 나눠봤는데요!💫

지난번 출연해서 주목받았으면 하는 가수로 꼽았던 실리카겔이 평론가님의 바람처럼 많은 사랑 받고 있는데요🤗
이번에 말씀해 주신 분들도 다음번 출연 때 많은 사랑을 받고 있을지 기대가 됩니다!☘️
그럼, 또 가장 추울 때 다시 만나요💕

As the first half passes and the second half begins, there is a person who naturally comes to mind!💖
We have the critic Yunha Kim🍒

Today, we looked back at the first half of 2024 and shared many stories!💫

Silica Gel was mentioned as the most expected rookie by Yunha Kim and they are eating this year without a doubt.🤗
We look forward to seeing if the artists who spoke this time will also receive a lot of love during their next appearance!☘️
Well then, let’s meet again when the second half ends💕
